newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Afcol warns weak demand to hit profits.
newsitem.headline: Afcol warns weak demand to hit profits.

text.p: Associated Furniture Companies Ltd said on Monday that earnings in the year to March 31, 1997, would be well below expectations due to a sharp deterioration in demand for furniture in the fourth quarter.

The company said in a statement that attributable earnings for the full year would be well below the level indicated at the time interim results were announced in November, although earnings would be above the 25.7 million rand recorded at the half year.
The company will publish year results on May 8.
